sendResetPasswordEmail.text:
Dear caregiver,

We received a request to reset your Bianca Wellness account password.

To reset your password, please click the link below:

%s

This reset link will expire in 1 hour for security purposes.

If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email. Your account remains secure.

Best regards,
The Bianca Wellness Team

clientConsentEmail.subject: Bianca Wellness - Consent Required for Call Recording
clientConsentEmail.title: Consent Required for Call Recording
clientConsentEmail.intro: Your healthcare organization, %s, uses Bianca Wellness to conduct wellness check calls. In accordance with applicable laws in your jurisdiction, we need your consent before we can record these calls.
clientConsentEmail.whyConsent: Some jurisdictions require consent from all parties before a call can be recorded. Your organization has enabled the "Require Patient Consent" setting, which means we need your explicit consent before recording any calls.
clientConsentEmail.consentBenefit1: Your wellness check calls may be recorded for quality assurance and care coordination purposes
clientConsentEmail.consentBenefit2: Recordings will be used to provide summaries and insights to your caregivers
clientConsentEmail.consentBenefit3: Recordings will be stored securely and in compliance with applicable privacy laws
clientConsentEmail.noConsentTitle: What happens if you don't consent:
clientConsentEmail.noConsent1: Calls will still be made, but they will not be recorded
clientConsentEmail.noConsent2: You may still receive wellness check calls from your organization
clientConsentEmail.expiryNote: This consent link will expire in 30 days for security purposes.
clientConsentEmail.contactInfo: If you have any questions or concerns, please contact your organization or email us at privacy@biancawellness.com.
clientConsentEmail.closing:
Best regards,
The Bianca Wellness Team

familyDigestEmailVerify.subject: Bianca Wellness - Verify weekly family digest email
familyDigestEmailVerify.title: Verify your email for weekly family digests
familyDigestEmailVerify.intro: %s uses Bianca Wellness to send optional weekly email summaries of wellness check-in calls to family contacts.
familyDigestEmailVerify.scopeNote: This link verifies your email address for weekly family digest emails only. It does not change emergency notifications or other communications. This message does not include health information.
familyDigestEmailVerify.expiryNote: This verification link expires in 24 hours for security.
familyDigestEmailVerify.contactInfo: If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it or contact your care facility.
familyDigestEmailVerify.closing:
Best regards,
The Bianca Wellness Team

caregiverDailyDigest.title: Daily care digest
caregiverDailyDigest.subtitle: Wellness check-ins for your assigned residents
caregiverDailyDigest.noActivity: No calls scheduled for this day.
caregiverDailyDigest.noAnswerToday: Call attempted; no conversation summary (not answered or too short).
caregiverDailyDigest.completedNoTranscript: Check-in completed; no written summary yet.
caregiverDailyDigest.languageMismatchExplanation: Conversation text is omitted because the resident's preferred language (%s) differs from yours (%s). Sentiment summary only.
caregiverDailyDigest.languageMismatchExplanationNoSentiment: Conversation text is omitted because the resident's preferred language (%s) differs from yours (%s). No sentiment analysis is available for these calls.
caregiverDailyDigest.emailScreenHint: Use “Email digest” to send a copy to your verified account email, or check “Email me when I build” when you generate the digest.
caregiverDailyDigest.emailPlainIntro: This message summarizes wellness check-ins for your assigned residents. Open the HTML version for the full layout.
caregiverDailyDigest.emailConfidentialFooter: Confidential — for the intended caregiver only. Do not forward.
caregiverDailyDigest.emailAiDisclaimer: This digest is automatically generated from wellness check-in calls. It is not clinical advice and should be reviewed alongside the original call record when decisions are needed.
caregiverDailyDigest.safeNoSummaryFallback: Check-in completed; no written summary is available yet.
